Then 2026-01-01 is Thursday? Wait, 2025 is not leap year, so 365 days later, day shift +1: Wednesday +1 = Thursday. So 2026-01-01 is Thursday. Then 2026-05-19: from Jan 1 to May 19: Jan 31 days, Feb 28 (2026 not leap), Mar 31, Apr 30, May 19. Sum: 31+28+31+30+19 = 139 days. 139 mod 7 = 139 - 7*19=139-133=6. So day shift +6 from Thursday: Thursday +6 = Wednesday? Wait, Thursday +6 days = Wednesday? Let's count: Thursday->Friday(1), Saturday(2), Sunday(3), Monday(4), Tuesday(5), Wednesday(6). Yes Wednesday. So 2026-05-19 is Wednesday. Next Friday after that is 2026-05-21. So date: 2026-05-21.

We need to find concerts near Berlin and Paris. The function expects location string. We can call twice: location "Berlin" and "Paris". date "2026-05-21", genre "Classical", amenities ["Parking"].
